sentences.en: Sociobiology studies how biology affects social behaviors in animals.
sentences.zh: 社会生物学研究生物因素如何影响动物的社会行为。

sentences.en: His book on sociobiology has been very influential among scientists.
sentences.zh: 他关于社会生物学的书在科学家当中很有影响力。

sentences.en: Many people find sociobiology controversial because it links genes to social behavior.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为社会生物学是有争议的，因为它将基因与社会行为联系起来。
